headline: President Clinton's 1999 order updates the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This executive order makes changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, the official guide for how military trials work. The manual covers rules for procedures, evidence, and punishments under military law. Only the title was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members facing military charges would be tried under the updated rules.

who_it_affects.group: Military judges, prosecutors, and defense lawyers
who_it_affects.how: They would follow the amended procedures and rules in courts-martial.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 6, 1999; the title does not say when the changes apply.
